item.title: TRUMP AMNESTY DEAL??? Trump Revives DACA DEAL With Dems | America First Ep. 1776
item.description:
Nick Fuentes reacts to Trump's post-midterm interview in which he signaled openness to a deal with Democrats on legal status for long-term illegal immigrants, reviving a DACA-style compromise. He argues the move betrays the 2016 and 2024 deportation promises, questions why DHS stopped reporting deportation numbers, and says the MAGA movement is finished. He also covers new congressional subpoenas, a push to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth, and urges supporters to get involved in the GOP before taking super chats.

item.title: RUBIO VS VANCE??? White House KNIFE FIGHT After Midterm ROUT | America First Ep. 1775
item.description:
Nick Fuentes covers reports of a White House palace war between Marco Rubio's circle and JD Vance's camp after the midterm rout, reading it as the start of the 2028 primary fight. He goes after Trump for blaming voters for the market sell-off, calling Trumpism a personality cult that deradicalized the right, and highlights a White House memo warning outside conservative groups. He also points to a surge of Young Republican applications as proof his strategy is working, then takes super chats.

item.description:

He blames the Iran war, the economy and Trump's broken promises, goes after pro-Israel donors and JD Vance's post-election analysis, and argues the party needs new leadership and must bring in his young nationalist base before 2028. The last hour is super chats, including talk about Vivek Ramaswamy's loss in Ohio.

item.title: ICE AGENTS DOXED??? Left Wing HACKTIVISTS DOX All ICE Agents | America First Ep. 1771
item.description:
Fuentes covers reports that left-wing hackers leaked personal data on ICE agents and FBI employees, and how that feeds a broader pressure campaign against immigration enforcement.
